description: Floating search panel for the diagram editor.

parameters.name: CurrentIndexChanged
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the currently highlighted match.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the active match index changes.

parameters.name: OnReplace
parameters.description: Error message displayed when the regex pattern is invalid.

parameters.name: OnReplaceAll
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks the Replace button.

parameters.name: RegexError
parameters.description: Fires when the regex toggle changes.

parameters.name: ReplaceQuery
parameters.description: Fires when the "search all pages" toggle changes.

parameters.name: SearchAllPages
parameters.description: Fires when the panel should close.

parameters.name: SearchAllPagesChanged
parameters.description: When true, search spans all pages instead of just the active one.

parameters.name: UseRegex
parameters.description: Fires when the replacement text changes.

parameters.name: UseRegexChanged
parameters.description: When true, the query is treated as a regular expression.
